title: WAC 192-540-040, How should employers report hours for each calendar quarter?

passages.question: How many hours go on the report for hourly and salaried employees?
passages.excerpt: Each calendar quarter, employers must report to the department the wages paid and the associated hours for each employee. ... (1) Hourly employees. Report the total number of hours worked by each employee. (2) Employees on salary. Report forty hours for each week in which a salaried employee as defined in WAC 192-500-100 worked. ... (4) Overtime. Report the number of hours actually worked for which overtime pay or compensatory time is provided, without regard to the amount of wages or compensation paid.
